reason: 5.11.5 fixes the sibling of the 5.11.4 evidence-classifier false positive: a git commit/tag/stash/notes message describing a destructive-command fix (rm -rf, curl | sh) was scanned as if it were the command and hard-blocked at 100. The classifier now exempts a lone git message command via a shell-quoting-correct code skeleton (command substitution and surviving operators still disqualify). Platform only; no Node/Python SDK surface change.
